facts.business: Parmax Pharma Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of pharmaceutical products and provides labour job work services.

auditor.name: M/s B A Shah S R Mehta & Co. - Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters reported: 1) Unsanctioned insurance claim receivable of Rs 350.57 Lakhs for fire incident; 2) Investment of Rs 40 Lakhs in mutual funds held in Managing Director's name contravening Section 187(1); 3) Non-provision of depreciation on clean room plant (Rs 2.03 Cr) and effluent treatment plant (Rs 7.40 Lakhs) due to non-usage; 4) Non-compliance with Ind AS 19 for employee benefits accounted on cash basis; 5) Acceptance of deposits of Rs 61.17 Lakhs from LLP contravening RBI directives and Companies Act provisions.

key_risks: Unsanctioned insurance claim receivable of Rs 350.57 Lakhs
Investments held in Managing Director's name contravening Section 187(1)
Non-provision of depreciation on significant assets (clean room plant and ETP)
Non-compliance with Ind AS 19 for employee benefits (cash basis accounting)
Acceptance of deposits from LLP contravening RBI directives and Companies Act
facts.related_party_note: Investment of Rs 40 Lakhs in mutual funds held in the name of Managing Director Umang A Gosalia instead of the company.
